subject: Orchestration checkpoint — delivery owners & runbook
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novushealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Saini <priya.s@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Novus launch — initial MAP + questions

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Priya and I pulled together an initial mutual action plan (attached) and a short list of technical questions the implementation team flagged when we reviewed the architecture doc. High level asks:

- Can you confirm who will own the infra readiness checklist (network/VPC, egress rules)?
- We have two go-live windows available in August (Aug 18–20) and September (Sep 15–17) — which would you recommend based on typical Redwood Dedicated lead times?
- Desired acceptance criteria: throughput test at 150 concurrent requests with p95 latency < 300ms for 512-token responses.

Attached: Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP), network_requirements.pdf (initial), runbook-draft.md (very rough).

Would love a short sync this week to align owners and set milestone dates. Priya — looping you so we can coordinate internal Novus resources.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Director, Platform Engineering
Novus Health


From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novushealth.com>
Cc: Priya Saini <priya.s@novushealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jul 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novus launch — initial MAP + questions

Thanks Sanjay — this is a great starting point. I’ve added Monica (CS lead for Novus) and Ben (Solutions Engineer) so we can capture technical owners and delivery windows. Quick answers up front:

- Infra readiness owner: Ben will drive the network/VPC checklist with your infra team; Monica will own acceptance criteria and user acceptance/QA coordination.
- Recommended go-live: we prefer the September window (Sep 15–17) to ensure reserved capacity and a full pre-cutover load test. August is possible but will require a short-notice Dedicated capacity request (we can, but it increases risk).
- Throughput target: noted — Ben, can you confirm feasibility for the 150 concurrent p95 < 300ms goal and call out any model/config tradeoffs?

Proposed quick next steps:
1) 30-min sync this Thu (Jul 3) 10:00–10:30 PT to confirm owners and fill dates in the MAP.
2) Ben to share an infrastructure gating checklist by Mon (Jul 7).
3) Monica to draft a two-week cutover acceptance test plan by Jul 11.

I updated the MAP with owner placeholders and a proposed milestone cadence — attaching Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx (v2).

Neha Kapoor
Sr Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183


From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novus launch — initial MAP + questions

On Wed, Jul 2, 2025 at 10:02 AM Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Sanjay — this is a great starting point. I’ve added Monica (CS lead for Novus) and Ben (Solutions Engineer) so we can capture technical owners and delivery windows.

Quick feasibility notes after an infra review with the infra team:

- 150 concurrent requests @ p95 < 300ms for 512 tokens is achievable on a Dedicated instance if we:
  * use the 8xA100 instance class (or equivalent),
  * enable KV-prefix caching for frequent prompt prefixes, and
  * apply int8 quantization on the model variant we plan to serve.

- Risks / blockers:
  * Network egress rules: we need static NATing for outbound telemetry and health checks to avoid connection drops during load tests. Novus networking will need to confirm a public egress IP range or set up a NAT gateway.
  * Certificate pinning: if Novus enforces strict client certs, we’ll need the cert chain 5 business days before the load test.

Proposed milestone table (owner / date):
- Jul 7: Infrastructure gating checklist (Ben) — completed (attached infrastructure-checklist.csv)
- Jul 14: Reserved capacity request submitted (Neha)
- Aug 18–20: Optional quick-cutover window (tentative)
- Aug 25–29: Pre-cutover load test (dev environment) — owner: Ben
- Sep 1–5: Staged failover and canary ramp — owner: Monica
- Sep 15: Production cutover target — owner: Monica + Novus ops

I’m attaching the infra checklist and a short runbook draft with the sequence for a staged ramp. I’ll also put together a short script for the throughput test and share it in the drive link.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: infrastructure-checklist.csv, runbook-draft.md


From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novushealth.com>, Priya Saini <priya.s@novushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novus launch — initial MAP + questions

Thanks team — good momentum here. Summary and agreed commitments below (please reply only if anything needs correction):

Mutual Action Plan — commitments and dates
- Owner: Ben Carter — Infrastructure gating checklist (completed Jul 7) — deliverables: network rules, NAT IPs, cert requirements.
- Owner: Neha Kapoor — Reserved capacity request submitted by Jul 14. Action: confirm instance class (8xA100) and reservation window for Sep 10–20.
- Owner: Monica Patel — Acceptance & cutover playbook draft by Jul 11; coordinate Novus QA for Sept 1–5 canary testing.
- Owner: Novus (Sanjay/Priya) — Confirm public egress IPs or provide NAT gateway details by Jul 10; provide cert chain (if cert pinning) by Jul 8.
- Owner: Ben Carter — Pre-cutover load test script and runbook (drive link) by Jul 21.
- Go-live target: Sep 15, 2025 (production cutover). Secondary window: Aug 18–20 (contingent on reserved capacity approval).

Key risks and mitigations
- Risk: Short notice capacity increases for August raise cost and scheduling risk. Mitigation: prefer Sep 15 cutover; Neha to secure reservation by Jul 14.
- Risk: Network egress/CIDR mismatch during load test. Mitigation: Novus to provide NAT/egress details by Jul 10; Ben to run a smoke connectivity test week of Jul 14.

Next steps / meeting cadence
- Weekly 30-min sync Tuesdays 10:00 PT starting Jul 15 (Monica to send recurring invite).
- Ben and Novus infra to run initial smoke connectivity test Jul 14–16.
- Neha to update the MAP in Drive and set milestone ownerships (done; see Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx (v3) in drive).

Attachments / Links
- Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx (v3) — updated milestone table and owners
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNovusMAP
- JIRA ticket for cutover tasks: OPS-1298

Thanks — I’ll circulate the meeting invite after Monica confirms the weekly cadence.
